verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document container tags as a hard tenancy boundary ('never returned by a search scoped to another tag'), with explicit examples scoping add/search calls by containerTag (e.g. user_123), and guidance to scope each end-user/tenant to a container tag for isolation and deletion. This directly matches the story of scoping memories per user/agent/app to prevent cross-tenant leakage. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual isolation behavior (community evidence is unrelated to tenancy) and more detail on agent-level or application-level scoping beyond user/tenant examples.
